question: Which additional deities complete this enumerated group?
premises: They belong to the same worship sequence.
inference: Cāritra, Camatkāra, Cañcala, and Cāru Bhūṣaṇa complete this part of the list.
uncertainties: cāru bhūṣaṇam appears as two tokens but functions as one name.
plain_english: Cāritra, Camatkāra, Cañcala, and Cāru Bhūṣaṇa.
